mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Subscribe (fromUserId, toUserId, createDate) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT u.id as userId, u.username, u.profileImageUrl, if((SELECT 1 FROM Subscribe WHERE fromUserId = #{principalId} AND toUserId = u.id), 1, 0) subscribeState, if( #{principalId} = u.id, 1, 0) equalUserState FROM User u INNER JOIN Subscribe S on u.id = S.toUserId WHERE fromUserId = #{pageUserId}
